title: Research: sharp 224 tariff for every recoding of the fixed P112 fit
body:
## Summary

```diff
 fixed literal P112 orthogonal-group fitting matrix K
- tariff 224 checked for its indicator queries
+ tariff 224 proved for every spanning query list in rowspace(K), over every field
```

Every rank-minimal factorization of this same K has sharp full-plane one-total tariff **224**, including arbitrary dense query recoding. The theorem also covers redundant queries constrained to that row space, and applies conditionally to any even orthonormal partition of P112. The concrete replay binds [PR3370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3370)'s rank-32 fit. [PR3345](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3345) and PR3370 already priced their literal indicators; this contribution closes the general recoding obligation.

Package: `research/plane-fit-recoding-tariff/`. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19008393).

## Evidence

- Before: the literal tariff was 224; a general scalar change of basis had no recorded lower-bound proof. After: a weighted spanning lemma proves the all-field minimum. The unchanged indicator basis attains it, while a dense exact recoding costs 288.
- Source-bound primary replay checks all 65,535 group closures, 11,392 forced mask entries and 37,632 dense factorization entries. A separate no-import checker verifies explicit-vector geometry and all 264,864 two-query invertible recodings. Seven behavioral groups include four actual CLI failures, a singular family and a query outside the row space.
- Python 3.12.15 registered replay, Python 3.15.0 optimized controls, read-only Git-free export, warning diagnostics, Ruff E/F/B/SIM/I/UP/PLW and formatting pass. Exact retained PR3370 certificate bytes and selected inputs are hash-bound. The pending source commit is not a runtime dependency.
- Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/plane-fit-recoding-tariff`. Standard library only. Proof, exact receipt, sources, limits and open questions are included.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. This adds one isolated theorem package.

Blast radius: package. The result fixes the literal matrix and the full-plane additive tariff. Other fitting row spaces, overcomplete queries outside that space, changed readers and shared native operations remain open. Physical supplier, all-size and full multiplication theorem obligations are unrun. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Frozen predecessors are unchanged.
